title: Local-human interactive Copilot runtime registration
description: Local Control UI input only, never an MCP/RPC payload. Importing this record does not enable an incompatible runtime. Identity and DPAPI protection are added by LocalSetup, not supplied by the document.

endpoint.description: Literal loopback IP, explicit TCP port 1-65535, and no userinfo, query, fragment, or non-root path; for example http://127.0.0.1:41235 or http://[::1]:41235. LocalSetup performs semantic validation.

connectionToken.description: Runtime-issued connection authentication secret. Enter only in the local password control/import flow, never through MCP or logs. It is not a GitHub credential and is stored only as DPAPI CurrentUser ciphertext.

sessionId.description: The exact session explicitly selected by the local human; never inferred from foreground.

workingDirectory.description: Existing canonical absolute local Windows directory without reparse points or overlap with broker-private data.

expiresAt.description: An explicit-offset timestamp in the future and at most 24 hours after import. LocalSetup enforces the relative expiry.
